note: Example sites for the app's 'Load an example' picker. Coordinates and capacities are cited where sourced; anything marked 'approximate' is a town-level or address-derived estimate, not a surveyed site boundary. Verify before publishing any figure drawn from these.

examples.name: Project River
examples.note: PFPI's anchor case. Bradley County, TN.

examples.name: Gainesville Renewable Energy Center

examples.name: Enviva Pellets Northampton

examples.name: Drax Amite BioEnergy
examples.note: Capacity reported as ~525,000 tonnes/yr, converted here to 578,713 short tons/yr. Gloster, MS (Amite County) -- coordinates are approximate (town-level, no street address found).
